discussion_comments.comment_body:
Valid, fixed in the latest push. A Retry click carries no attachments of its own: protobuf decodes the omitted `images` field as `[]`, so `images ?? retry.images` kept the empty list. The retry now uses `images?.length ? images : retry.images`, so the failed start's attachments go to the retried sandbox unless the response actually carries some. Covered by `keeps the original attachments when Retry arrives with the webview's empty image list` in `SdkController.test.ts`, which sends Retry with `[]` and fails without the fix.

The same push merges `main` into this branch (the only conflict was in `state-keys.ts`, where `main` removed the focus-chain setting next to the new cloud keys). On the merged result, the full extension type check, vitest (1,452), `test:cloud` (23), the bun unit tests and the webview tests (584) all pass.
